---
title: Xurl
description: Official X API command-line client
---

This package pins the upstream Linux x86-64 release through
`rules_binary_toolchain`. The `xurl` alias is available to `//tools/xurl`.
The archive version and integrity are owned by `binary_toolchain.json`.

The upstream release archive includes its MIT license and copyright notice.
